title: 66:1 The heaven is my throne/the earth is my footstool. The Lord rules over heaven and earth; all things in all places are subject to him. As the Lord said to Abraham, "I am the Lord thy God; I dwell in heaven; the earth is my footstool; I stretch my hand over the sea, and it obeys my voice; I cause the wind and the fire to be my chariot; I say to the mountains—Depart . . . and behold, they are taken away" (Abr. 2:7).
author: Tina M. Peterson
